title: Polyphyllin I ameliorates gefitinib resistance and inhibits the VEGF/VEGFR2/p38 pathway by targeting HIF-1a in lung adenocarcinoma.
authors: Zhang, Dengtian; Tian, Xinchen; Wang, Youzhi; Liu, Fen; Zhang, Jiaqi; Wang, Haochen; Zhang, Ni; Yan, Tinghao; Lin, Cong; Shi, Zhan; Liu, Rui; Jiang, Shulong
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究药物Polyphyllin I通过HIF-1a降解克服肺癌耐药，核心为细胞与信号通路实验，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) is the most common pathological type of lung cancer. Epidermal growth factor receptor tyrosine kinase inhibitors (EGFR-TKIs) have been administered as the first-line therapy for patients with EGFR mutations in LUAD, but it is almost inevitable that resistance to EGFR-TKIs therapy eventually arises. Polyphyllin I (PPI), derived from Paris polyphylla rhizomes, has been shown to have potent anti-cancer properties in a range of human cancer types including LUAD. However, the role of PPI in gefitinib resistance and the underlying mechanism remain elusive. PURPOSE: To evaluate the antitumor impacts of PPI on gefitinib resistance cells and investigate its molecular mechanism. METHODS: CCK-8, wound healing, transwell assay, and xenograft model were performed to determine the anti-cancer effects of PPI as well as its ability to overcome gefitinib resistance. Immunoblotting, co-immunoprecipitation, phospho-RTK antibody array, qRT-PCR, and immunofluorescence were utilized to explore the mechanism by which PPI overrides gefitinib resistance. RESULTS: PPI inhibited cell survival, growth, and migration/invasion in both gefitinib-sensitive (PC9) and -resistant (PC9/GR) LUAD cells (IC(50) at 2.0 muM). Significantly, treatment with PPI at 1.0 muM resensitized the resistant cells to gefitinib. Moreover, cell-derived xenograft experiments revealed that the combination of PPI and gefitinib overcame gefitinib resistance. The phospho-RTK array and immunoblotting analyses showed PPI significant inhibition of the VEGFR2/p38 pathway. In addition, molecular docking suggested the interaction between PPI and HIF-1alpha. Mechanistically, PPI reduced the protein expression of HIF-1alpha in both normoxia and hypoxia conditions by triggering HIF-1alpha degradation. Moreover, HIF-1alpha protein but not mRNA level was elevated in gefitinib-resistant LUAD. We further demonstrated that PPI considerably facilitated the binding of HIF-1alpha to VHL. CONCLUSIONS: We present a novel discovery demonstrating that PPI effectively counteracts gefitinib resistance in LUAD by modulating the VEGF/VEGFR2/p38 pathway. Mechanistic investigations unveil that PPI facilitates the formation of the HIF-1alpha /VHL complex, leading to the degradation of HIF-1alpha and subsequent inhibition of angiogenesis. These findings uncover a previously unidentified mechanism governing HIF-1alpha expression in reaction to PPI, providing a promising method for therapeutic interventions targeting EGFR-TKI resistance in LUAD.
abstract_zh: 背景：肺腺癌（LUAD）是最常见的肺癌病理类型。表皮生长因子受体酪氨酸激酶抑制剂（EGFR-TKIs）已被用作携带EGFR突变的LUAD患者的一线治疗，但耐药性的出现几乎不可避免。重楼皂苷I（PPI）来源于重楼根茎，已被证明在包括LUAD在内的多种人类癌症类型中具有强效的抗癌特性。然而，PPI在吉非替尼耐药中的作用及其潜在机制仍不清楚。目的：评估PPI对吉非替尼耐药细胞的抗肿瘤影响，并探讨其分子机制。方法：采用CCK-8、伤口愈合、Transwell实验和异种移植模型来测定PPI的抗癌效果及其克服吉非替尼耐药的能力。利用免疫印迹、免疫共沉淀、磷酸化RTK抗体芯片、qRT-PCR和免疫荧光技术来探索PPI克服吉非替尼耐药的机制。结果：PPI在吉非替尼敏感（PC9）和耐药（PC9/GR）LUAD细胞中均抑制了细胞存活、生长和迁移/侵袭（IC(50)为2.0 μM）。值得注意的是，以1.0 μM的PPI处理可使耐药细胞对吉非替尼重新敏感。此外，细胞源性异种移植实验表明，PPI与吉非替尼联合使用可克服吉非替尼耐药。磷酸化RTK芯片和免疫印迹分析显示，PPI显著抑制了VEGFR2/p38通路。此外，分子对接提示PPI与HIF-1α之间存在相互作用。机制上，PPI通过触发HIF-1α降解，在常氧和低氧条件下均降低了HIF-1α的蛋白表达。此外，在吉非替尼耐药的LUAD中，HIF-1α蛋白水平升高，而mRNA水平未变。我们进一步证明，PPI显著促进了HIF-1α与VHL的结合。结论：我们提出了一项新发现，表明PPI通过调节VEGF/VEGFR2/p38通路有效对抗LUAD中的吉非替尼耐药。机制研究揭示，PPI促进HIF-1α/VHL复合物的形成，导致HIF-1α降解并随后抑制血管生成。这些发现揭示了一种先前未识别的、响应PPI调控HIF-1α表达的机制，为针对LUAD中EGFR-TKI耐药的治疗干预提供了一种有前景的方法。
